title_vi: I was doing (thì quá khứ tiếp diễn)
theory_html:
A. Example: Paul

A. Ví dụ: Paul

It is 6 o’clock now. Paul is at home. He is watching TV.

Bây giờ là 6 giờ. Paul đang ở nhà. Anh ấy đang xem TV.

At 4 o’clock he wasn’t at home. He was at the sports club. He was swimming in the pool. He wasn’t watching TV.

Lúc 4 giờ anh ấy không ở nhà. Anh ấy ở câu lạc bộ thể thao. Anh ấy đang bơi trong hồ. Anh ấy không xem TV.

He started swimming at 3.30 and finished at 4.15 – at 4.00 he was swimming.

Anh ấy bắt đầu bơi lúc 3 giờ 30 và bơi xong lúc 4 giờ 15 – lúc 4 giờ anh ấy đang bơi.

B. was/were + -ing is the past continuous

B. was/were + -ing là thì quá khứ tiếp diễn

positive
khẳng định		negative
phủ định		question
câu hỏi
I / he / she / itwas doing / watching / playing / swimming / livingwas not (wasn’t) doing …was I / he / she / it doing …?
we / you / theywere doing / watching …were not (weren’t) doing …were we / you / they doing …?

  • What were you doing at 11.30 yesterday? Were you working?

    Lúc 11 giờ 30 hôm qua bạn đang làm gì? Bạn có đang làm việc không?

  • ‘What did he say?’ ‘I don’t know. I wasn’t listening.’

    ‘Anh ấy đã nói gì?’ ‘Tôi không biết. Lúc đó tôi không nghe.’

  • It was raining, so we didn’t go out.

    Trời đang mưa, nên chúng tôi không ra ngoài.

  • In 2009 we were living in Canada.

    Năm 2009 chúng tôi đang sống ở Canada.

  • Today she’s wearing a skirt, but yesterday she was wearing trousers.

    Hôm nay cô ấy mặc váy, nhưng hôm qua cô ấy mặc quần dài.

  • I woke up early yesterday. It was a beautiful morning. The sun was shining and the birds were singing.

    Hôm qua tôi dậy sớm. Đó là một buổi sáng đẹp trời. Mặt trời đang chiếu sáng và chim đang hót.

Spelling (live → living / run → running / lie → lying etc.) → Appendix 5

Chính tả (live → living / run → running / lie → lying v.v.) → Phụ lục 5

C. am/is/are + -ing (present) → was/were + -ing (past)

C. am/is/are + -ing (hiện tại) → was/were + -ing (quá khứ)

present
hiện tại		past
quá khứ
I’m working (now).I was working at 10.30 last night.
It isn’t raining (now).It wasn’t raining when we went out.
What are you doing (now)?What were you doing at 3 o’clock?

mcq.question: At 4 o’clock he wasn’t at home. He ___ in the pool.
mcq.full: At 4 o’clock he wasn’t at home. He was swimming in the pool.
mcq.vi: Lúc 4 giờ anh ấy không ở nhà. Anh ấy đang bơi trong hồ.
mcq.expl:
Past continuous = was/were + -ing: in the middle of an action at a time in the past (he was swimming at 4 o’clock).
Quá khứ tiếp diễn = was/were + -ing: đang làm dở việc gì vào một thời điểm trong quá khứ (lúc 4 giờ anh ấy đang bơi).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Đang làm dở lúc 4 giờ → was + -ing.
mcq.key: At 4 o’clock he wasn’t at home. He ___ in the pool.|was swimming

Điểm ngữ pháp: he → wasn’t + -ing.
mcq.key: At 4 o’clock he ___ TV.|wasn’t watching
